annotation.title_clean: Selecting appropriate artificial intelligence development strategy
annotation.title_en: Selecting appropriate artificial intelligence development strategy
annotation.venue: Ministry of Science and Technology portal (english.mic.gov.vn)
annotation.summary_en: 2019 news article on the Vietnamese Ministry of Science and Technology portal arguing Vietnam needs its own AI development direction. It notes weak data, infrastructure and human resources, and urges preferential state policies for talent, diaspora engagement and shared data platforms. It contains no robotics or risk governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Vietnam has a lower AI starting point and lacks large databases, infrastructure and AI training capacity.
The State should develop preferential policies for training and developing high-tech talent.
Connect Vietnamese AI experts abroad and encourage their contribution.
Connect spontaneous AI communities to share data and build a common AI platform.
